items.question: Within how many days after the end of a tax period must taxable businesses file a VAT return with the Federal Tax Authority in the UAE?
items.gold: Usually within 28 days of the end of the tax period.
items.fact: VAT returns due within 28 days after tax period ends

items.question: How must a taxable person file a VAT return in the UAE with the Federal Tax Authority?
items.gold: Electronically through the FTA portal, EmaraTax.
items.fact: VAT returns filed electronically via EmaraTax portal
